Class ScenarioProceduralTensorRasterizer

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.scenario.ScenarioProceduralTensorRasterizer
public final class ScenarioProceduralTensorRasterizer extends Object
Procedural raster generator for multi-field cultural tensors.

Simulates spatial cultural distributions based on parameterized Langevin-SDE formulas: \[ d\mathbf{C}_i = \alpha \nabla^2 \mathbf{C}_i \, dt + \sigma \, d\mathbf{W}_t \] coupling geographical coordinates, elevation barriers, and stochastic seeds.

Version:
1.0.0
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
